functions.name: get_arousal
functions.description: Read the current (pull-based) arousal value. Complements the reactive arousal_change event.

functions.name: get_pressure
functions.description: Read the most recent raw pressure sensor reading.

functions.name: get_pressure_average
functions.description: Read the smoothed/averaged pressure reading.

functions.name: get_arousal_threshold
functions.description: Read the configured arousal (sensitivity) threshold.

functions.name: set_arousal_threshold
functions.description: Set the arousal (sensitivity) threshold.

args.name: threshold
args.description: New threshold value (floored to 10 by firmware)

functions.name: increment_arousal_threshold
functions.description: Increment the arousal (sensitivity) threshold by a relative amount.

functions.name: ble_write
functions.description: Write data to a BLE GATT characteristic (with response).

args.name: data
args.description: Data to send (string or byte array)

functions.name: ble_write_no_response
functions.description: Write data to a BLE GATT characteristic (without response).

args.name: data
args.description: Data to send (string or byte array)

functions.name: get_system_config
functions.description: Read a system configuration value by key. @TODO This should return typed values.

functions.name: set_system_config
functions.description: Write a system configuration value by key.

functions.name: get_motor_speed
functions.description: Read the current commanded motor speed.

functions.name: get_output_mode
functions.description: Read the current output mode.

functions.name: request_motor_control
functions.description: Claim exclusive plugin control of the motor. While held, the firmware's built-in auto-edging state machine stands down and set_motor_speed() becomes effective.

functions.name: release_motor_control
functions.description: Release plugin motor control, returning the device to manual mode.

functions.name: set_motor_speed
functions.description: Directly set the motor speed. Only takes effect while this plugin holds motor control via request_motor_control().

functions.name: delay
functions.description: Pause plugin execution for a given number of milliseconds.

functions.name: log
functions.description: Log a message to the device console. The plugin name is prepended for identification.

args.name: msg
args.description: Message to log (string, int, or float)

functions.name: random
functions.description: Generate a random integer using the hardware RNG. 0 args: raw uint32. 1 arg: [0, hi). 2 args: [lo, hi].

args.name: lo
args.description: Lower bound (or upper bound if only one arg)

returns.description: Random integer in the specified range

functions.name: millis
functions.description: Get milliseconds elapsed since device boot. Uses esp_timer_get_time() (microseconds) divided by 1000.

functions.name: set_led_color
functions.description: Set the rotary encoder's RGB status LED.

functions.name: notify
functions.description: Show a user-visible toast notification on the device screen.

functions.name: lock_controls
functions.description: Lock all button/encoder input at the UI layer. The only way out is holding BACK+OK for 5s, or a power cycle.

args.name: reason
args.description: Shown in device logs while locked

functions.name: unlock_controls
functions.description: Release a lock previously engaged via lock_controls().

events.name: mode_set
events.description: Fires when the active operating mode changes.

events.name: speed_change
events.description: Fires when the motor speed changes.

events.name: arousal_change
events.description: Fires when the arousal level changes.

events.name: orgasm_denial
events.description: Fires when an orgasm is denied (edge detected).

events.name: orgasm_permit
events.description: Fires when arousal breaches the threshold but the vibration mode controller permits continued stimulation instead of denying.

events.name: edge_start
events.description: Fires when edging starts (near-orgasm detection begins).

events.name: connect
events.description: Fires when a BLE peripheral connects.

events.name: disconnect
events.description: Fires when a BLE peripheral disconnects.

events.name: tick
events.description: Fires on each main loop tick (periodic heartbeat).
